name: Ashiyana Heights
shortDescription: Seven-storey sea-view condominium of 131 studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments on Soi Patak 2, a short drive from Kata Beach.
description:
One seven-storey building with 131 apartments on a plot of about 1,760 sqm in the Karon sub-district, between Karon and Kata and about 1.4 km from Kata Beach. Studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom layouts are on sale, from around 29 sqm to 77 sqm.
The developer shows a rooftop sea-view pool and bar-restaurant, gym, sauna with ice bath, garden and lobby. Parking is provided for 34 cars and 18 motorcycles.
Completion is advertised for December 2028 on the main property portal; some sources give an earlier date, so confirm the schedule before reserving. Foreign buyers can hold freehold title within the 49% foreign quota.
